description:
Brain Fog Music | Bansuri & Tanpura | 1.5 Hours of calm Indian instrumental music to clear a tired head

You know the feeling — the day is not over, but your head is. Thoughts feel slow, everything takes twice as long, and what you actually need is quiet.

This peaceful Indian ambient music gives your mind 90 minutes of low, steady calm so the fog can lift on its own.

You'll hear a breath-driven bamboo flute carrying long, unhurried phrases over a soft tanpura drone — no percussion, no sudden changes, nothing that asks for your attention.

Perfect for clearing your head after work, an evening reset, reading without noise, winding down a busy mind, or easing the transition from work to home.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri
Raga: Yaman — the classic evening raga, warm and settling
Style: Indian classical ambient, instrumental only
Mood: Quiet, steady, clearing
Duration: 1.5 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on when the workday ends and let it run. Speaker or headphones both work — keep it just under conversation volume and let it sit behind whatever you're doing.

⏱ CHAPTERS
